title: How Texas Sellers Can Verify a Cash Home Buyer
description: Before signing a Texas cash house offer, verify the buyer's identity, entity, funds, title company, written terms and closing contacts with this checklist.
author: CashAsIs
supportingKeywords: how to check a cash buyer for a house
cash buyer proof of funds Texas
imageAlt: Illustrative Texas brick house, keys and blank transaction folder with Cash Buyer Verify First headline and the official transparent Cash As-Is logo

faq.q: Should a Texas seller ask a cash buyer for proof of funds?
faq.a: It is reasonable to request current evidence that supports the proposed purchase and to ask how the named buyer relates to the account or funding source. Protect sensitive information and remember that a document alone does not guarantee closing.

faq.q: Does an active Texas business status prove a home buyer is trustworthy?
faq.a: No. It can help match a legal entity name and current public status, but it does not prove available funds, experience, contract performance or integrity. Use several independent checks.

faq.q: Does a cash home buyer need a real estate license in Texas?
faq.a: Do not assume every principal buying for its own account must hold a brokerage license. If someone claims to be a Texas broker or sales agent, verify that claim with TREC and understand whom that person represents.

faq.q: Is earnest money or an option fee required in every cash purchase agreement?
faq.a: No single payment structure describes every agreement. Read the actual written contract and ask a Texas real estate attorney about unfamiliar terms; do not infer buyer reliability from one clause alone.
